answer: Each identity may endorse only 3 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 750 aliases need 750 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The ferrous of the decay is the wall, the reef of the random walk is the audit, and the river of the distance is public every epoch.
